site-a.subtitle: ANYANG PUBLIC ART PROJECT 8TH
site-a.title: Digital Peach Blossom Spring
site-a.desc: The utopian 'Peach Blossom Spring' from traditional Eastern paintings merges with modern technology, creating a space where futuristic media art and digital sculptures coexist.
site-a.conceptTitle: Where Boundaries Blur: Human, Nature, Virtual
site-a.conceptDesc: By overlaying digital lights, sensor-linked sculptures, and virtual metaverse layers onto Anyang's forests and streams, we create a meta-utopia that transcends reality.
site-a.programDesc: Introducing the key programs of APAP8 designed with Anyang's futuristic values.
site-a.visitDesc: Outdoor media and sculpture exhibitions situated in Anyang Art Park and Anyang Stream are open to everyone.
